mapper.select: SELECT sign_in_ahead_minutes, queue_poll_seconds, appointment_cancel_hours, refund_enabled, update_time FROM system_config WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE system_config SET sign_in_ahead_minutes = #{request.signInAheadMinutes}, queue_poll_seconds = #{request.queuePollSeconds}, appointment_cancel_hours = #{request.appointmentCancelHours}, refund_enabled = #{request.refundEnabled}, updated_by = #{adminId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_id, operation_type, action, target_type, target_id, target, reason, result ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, 'SYSTEM_CONFIG', 'UPDATE', 'CONFIG', 1, '平台业务参数', NULL, '成功' )
